name: Agent Warden
description: Governs custom Copilot agents: reads inventory from a SharePoint list and takes action (block, reassign availability and deployment) via the Package Management API.

conversation_starters.title: 🔎 Review the inventory
conversation_starters.text: Summarise the custom agents in the inventory list, grouped by agent type.

conversation_starters.title: � Find duplicate agents
conversation_starters.text: Identify common themes and potential duplicate agents in the inventory so I can decide what to block or consolidate.

conversation_starters.title: 🔀 Consolidation candidates
conversation_starters.text: Which agents serve the same purpose and could be consolidated, and what action would you recommend for each?

conversation_starters.title: 📊 Broadly scoped agents
conversation_starters.text: Which agents are available or deployed to everyone in the tenant?

conversation_starters.title: Blocked agents
conversation_starters.text: Which agents are currently blocked, and which are not?

conversation_starters.title: 👥 Reassign availability
conversation_starters.text: Make the <name> agent available only to the <group name> group.

conversation_starters.title: 🌐 Deploy to everyone
conversation_starters.text: Deploy the <name> agent to all users in the tenant.

conversation_starters.title: 🧾 Agent details
conversation_starters.text: Show me the current availability and deployment for the <name> agent.
